title: Puppy holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Puppy body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f0c999'/>
  <!-- Back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='88' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#b57536'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='88' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#b57536'/>
  <!-- Front paws holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='64' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#f0c999'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='64' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#f0c999'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='20' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='34' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#8a5222' transform='rotate(-20 30 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='34' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#8a5222' transform='rotate(20 70 34)'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f0c999'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46 51 Q50 55 54 51' stroke='#5a3a1a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#e8709a'/>
  <!-- Heart held between paws -->
  <path d='M50 30 C50 24 42 22 42 29 C42 24 34 24 34 30 C34 38 50 48 50 48 C50 48 66 38 66 30 C66 24 58 24 58 29 C58 22 50 24 50 30 Z' fill='#ff4d6d' transform='translate(0 22) scale(0.85) translate(9 3)'/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d='M46 46 C46 43 43 42 43 45' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
